comparison.objective: Transfer a casualty manikin to a stretcher while preserving head-body alignment; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Manikin transfer tests whole-body support, coordinated lifting, and alignment. Candidate tests small-tool manipulation, fine rotation, locking torque, and iterative impact diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: The casualty must reach the stretcher without head misalignment; candidate must achieve two safe, repeatable stops and setting retention. Detailed transfer thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Whole-body transfer and damper commissioning test different physical abilities.
